key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.  One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED
  libraries, or to executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS property set.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
  cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
  CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
root_cause: The CMake configure step for both Android build variants (arm64 and x64) fails because `ov_generate_plugins_hpp` in `cmake/extra_modules.cmake` calls `ov_target_link_plugins` which attempts to link MODULE_LIBRARY targets (plugin .so files like openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, etc.) into another target. CMake disallows linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets. This appears to be a pre-existing regression in the Android CMake build configuration unrelated to the PR's change (docs/requirements.txt bump of mistune). The PR only changes a Python doc dependency and cannot have introduced this CMake error. This is likely a pre-existing issue on the master branch or a conflicting change in the merge queue.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to build OpenVINO for Android (arm64 or x64) with CMake and observe the configure step failure at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275.
recommended_actions: Investigate recent changes to cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake or cmake/extra_modules.cmake that may have introduced the MODULE_LIBRARY linking attempt
Check if another PR in the merge queue at the same time introduced a CMake change that caused this regression
The mistune bump PR itself is unrelated and should be re-queued once the CMake issue is resolved
prevention_strategies: Run Android CMake configure validation in pre-commit CI for changes to any cmake/ files, particularly plugins.cmake and extra_modules.cmake.
historical_context: No prior occurrence of this specific CMake error pattern in the investigation database.
